thread:
Dana L.: FYI just closed HelixMed (clinical search). 30 seats, Dedicated + VPC. They want a 14d on-prem eval and embeddings for semantic search. Billing term 12mo net30. Customer sensitive to cost — asked for a quantized model recommendation. Deal doc: https://paper.example/helixmed-9002. Can CS pick up?

Priya S.: Taking this. I'll own onboarding + success metrics. Highlights: SSO via Okta, Splunk logging endpoint, exportable audit logs, POC targets (search recall > 0.85 on test set).

Gabe R.: Support note: need expected qps and average tokens. Also confirm whether embeddings are generated server-side or client-side.

Dana L.: Expect baseline ~15 r/s, spikes to 60 r/s during batch imports. Typical input size 800 tokens. Embeddings will be server-side; they want compressed float16/quantized vectors to save space.

Linh T.: Eng ask: if they want quantized model we need to pick model family and precision. Also on-prem eval needs a checklist for audit & data handling. I'll open GH issue rwinf/ops#9002 and tag runtime/quantization.

Priya S.: I'll schedule kickoff with Helix infra (point: Omar). Tentative Wed 9am PT. Also capturing owners: onboarding = Priya S.; infra provisioning = Linh T.; support runbook = Gabe R.; finance billing = Marco V.

Marco V.: Finance: noted net30. Renewal: set renewal-watch if they request cost guarantees. Ask: do we have an approved commercial credit for health sector?

Dana L.: No credit applied. Helix asked for a 10% cap on price increases in contract. Flagging as potential renewal risk.

ticket-bot: New support ticket created: HELIX-9002-provision (https://zendesk.example/tickets/90212). Assignee: Gabe R.

Gabe R.: Created ticket and pasted initial provisioning payload. Need SAML XML and Splunk ingestion details. Sample payload I pasted:
```
POST /provision
{ "account_id": "HELIX-9002", "env": "dedicated", "vpc": true, "mTLS": true, "embeddings": {"type": "on-server", "format": "quantized-fp16"} }
```
Please attach SAML metadata and Splunk HEC token to the ticket.

Priya S.: I updated the deal doc with owners and POC success criteria. Action items:
- Priya: run customer kickoff + capture recall eval dataset (owner: Priya S.)
- Linh: land GH issue for quantization + on-prem checklist (owner: Linh T.)
- Gabe: build support runbook and provision sandbox (owner: Gabe R.)
- Marco: confirm invoicing cadence and flag renewal review at month 9 (owner: Marco V.)
- Dana: share Okta SAML and Splunk HEC details (owner: Dana L.)

Linh T.: Opened rwinf/ops#9002 with runtime/quantization label. Need to confirm expected peak tokens and model family (we recommend Llama3-small-8b quantized or a smaller open model depending on latency).

Dana L.: I'll ask Omar to send SAML and HEC by EOD. Also confirming they can accept KMS-encrypted keys; Helix security prefers HSM in prod but KMS OK for eval.

Priya S.: Scheduling kickoff Wed 9am PT. Invite includes pre-read: onboarding checklist, POC metrics, security reqs.

Gabe R.: Sandbox provisioning queued. I'll post the sandbox access link to the ticket once ready.

Priya S.: Summarized in internal trackers. Please ping if anything else. :thumbsup:
